{{Quote|Got some parts to collect from MandalMotors, and then we can be on our way.|[[Parja Bralor]]|<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>}}
'''MandalMotors tower''' was the headquarters of the [[MandalMotors/Legends|MandalMotors]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] company, located on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], within the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]]. Standing at one hundred [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall, the tower was adorned with MandalMotors' [[Mythosaur/Legends|mythosaur]] [[Skeleton/Legends|skull]] logo, and was a well-recognized landmark throughout the city. In addition to the company's production facilities, [[Engineer/Legends|engineering]] workshops, sheds, and [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]] surrounded the tower's base, and MandalMotors' headquarters was also equipped with its own private landing strip independent of the [[Keldabe spaceport]].

Built [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], MandalMotors tower was the center of production for the company's [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of starship manufacturing. Amidst the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning Clone Wars, MandalMotors tower was captured by [[Spar|Mandalore the Resurrector's]] [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protectors]] when he led the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] into an alliance with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] after the war came to an end, MandalMotors' headquarters was damaged during the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]]'s [[Battle of Mandalore (Yuuzhan Vong War)|attack]] on Mandalore, leaving scars so severe that they could still be seen decades later.

==Description==
[[File:MandalMotors.svg|thumb|right|180px|MandalMotors tower prominently displayed the company's logo.]]
The headquarters of the [[MandalMotors/Legends|MandalMotors]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] company, MandalMotors tower was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. Situated in the planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]], the MandalMotors tower stood one hundred [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall,<ref name="APM" /> and was adorned with the corporation's large [[Mythosaur/Legends|mythosaur]] [[Skeleton/Legends|skull]] logo.<ref name="Revelation">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref> The tower's size made it a Keldabe landmark, and [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] would use it as a point of navigational reference when approaching [[Keldabe spaceport|Keldabe's spaceport]]. Around the tower's base stood a series of additional [[Engineer/Legends|engineering]] workshops,<ref name="APM" /> in addition to a private landing strip, and a research wing consisting of a number of interconnected sheds and [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]] that, while run-down and unassuming on the outside, housed advanced technology and company prototypes within. The tower also housed a portion of the company's production facilities.<ref name="Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref>

==History==
MandalMotors tower was built [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]-spanning conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. By this point, the tower had already become an easily recognizable facet of Keldabe's skyline,<ref name="O66" /> and had been in used in the business of creating quality starships for a significant time.<ref name="HotM">{{InsiderCite|80|The History of the Mandalorians: Exploring the Evolution of a Mighty Race of Warriors}}</ref> MandalMotors customers could collect parts and equipment from the company headquarters.<ref name="O66" /> After the foundation of the [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protectors]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the newly risen [[Spar|Mandalore the Resurrector]] led his [[Troop/Legends|troops]] to capture the facilities of MandalMotors for exclusive use by the Confederacy, with whom he had recently allied the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] with.<ref name="HotM" /> Despite the habit of using the tower as a navigational landmark many Mandalorian pilots had adopted, when the Republic was [[Declaration of a New Order|transformed]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial forces]] arrived on Mandalore to establish a [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] on land leased out by the clans, Imperial [[Multi-Altitude Assault Transport|gunships]] nearly clipped the top of MandalMotors tower during a low-flying sweep over the capital city.<ref name="O66" />

In [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> long after the Empire had [[Battle of Endor/Legends|fallen]] and Imperial forces were [[Battle of the City of Bone|driven]] from Mandalore, the planet was [[Battle of Mandalore (Yuuzhan Vong War)|attacked]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] invaders known as the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. Though the Mandalorians were able to repel the Yuuzhan Vong attackers, many Mandalorian [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] were [[Death/Legends|killed]] and the planet Mandalore itself suffered significant damage; MandalMotors tower incurred battle scars and scorch marks that remained for decades after.<ref name="Sacrifice" />

In the time leading up to the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], MandalMotors was developing the starship prototype known as the ''Kyr'galaar'', housed at MandalMotors tower's research wing. However, with the fresh lode of [[Beskar/Legends|''beskar'']] [[Iron/Legends|iron]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]] found on Mandalore in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], the company redesigned the ''Kyr'galaar'' as the new [[Bes'uliik|''Bes'uliik''-class assault fighter]], and MandalMotors [[Chief Executive Officer/Legends|CEO]] [[Jir Yomaget]] met with reigning [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] at the tower's research wing to debut the new [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]. With Fett's approval of the designs, the production of a series of ''Bes'uliik'' prototypes was brought underway at MandalMotors tower's manufacturing facilities.<ref name="Sacrifice" />

==Behind the scenes==
MandalMotors tower was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' univeres in the [[2006]] [[EBook|e-novella]], ''[[Boba Fett: A Practical Man]]'' by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="APM" /> The tower continued to feature in further works by Traviss, including the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' novels [[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice|''Sacrifice'']]<ref name="Sacrifice" /> and [[Legacy of the Force: Revelation|''Revelation'']],<ref name="Revelation" /> and the [[Republic Commando|''Republic'' and ''Imperial Commando'']] novels, [[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel|''Order 66'']]<ref name="O66" /> and ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''.<ref name="ImpCom501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>
